verdict.rationale: GitHub Mobile docs describe assigning issues to Copilot for autonomous PR creation, managing Copilot cloud 'Agent Tasks', natural-language Copilot chat for code Q&A, and Copilot-driven code review—all clearly delegating tasks to a built-in AI assistant. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of these AI-specific features (community evidence predates Copilot integration and only covers general mobile app UX/bugs), and no detail on reliability or limits of the delegation flow.
